translations.web: For Yahweh is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.
translations.bsb: For the LORD is righteous; He loves justice. The upright will see His face.
translations.kjv: For the righteous LORD loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.
translations.asv: For Jehovah is righteous; he loveth righteousness: The upright shall behold his face. Psalm 12 For the Chief Musician; set to the Sheminith. A Psalm of David.
